title: APC Presents Tinubu with 2027 Presidential Certificate of Return in Abuja Ceremony
detail: APC National Chairman Nentawe Yilwatda presented President Bola Tinubu with the party flag and Certificate of Return as the APC's 2027 presidential candidate at a formal ceremony held at the Bola Ahmed Tinubu International Conference Centre in Abuja. The presentation followed the collation of results from the May 23 nationwide direct presidential primary in which Tinubu received approximately 10.9 million votes. Senior APC governors, National Assembly members, and party chieftains attended the ceremony. Tinubu used the occasion to thank the party faithful and emphasize continuity of his 'Renewed Hope' economic agenda, citing stabilization of the naira, stock market growth (the All Share Index reportedly rose from 53,000 to 250,000 between May 2023 and May 2026), and improved oil production. The formalization of Tinubu's candidacy sets the stage for what is expected to be a fiercely contested 2027 general election, with opposition parties—including the PDP (Atiku bloc), Labour Party (Peter Obi), and a potential Goodluck Jonathan independent or third-party bid—gearing up for a multi-way challenge to APC's incumbency advantage.
